name: Mega menu
summary: Panel below the Header for a main link with many subpages: 2 to 4 columns with a heading and links (icon, title, one line of description), and an optional featured block. Header renders it for links with a menu.
use: Websites with many pages per section: product, solutions, resources.
avoid: A few subpages: link to an overview page instead.
anatomy: Columns: heading and Mega menu links.
Mega menu link: icon, title, description.
Featured (optional): image, title, text and a link.
figmaProps: Show column 3 / Show column 4 / Show link 3 / Show link 4 / Show featured
Current: the page you are on.
_Mega menu link: Show icon / Icon / Show description
reactProps: { heading, links: { label, href, description?, icon?, current? }[] }[]
Usually <MegaMenuFeatured title media actions>. action is deprecated (removed in 2.0.0).
One link, for a custom panel.
behaviour: Opens on click of its Header nav item, not on hover: hover menus open by accident and do not work on touch.
The spacing between links is the padding of the link; there is no gap. The column heading is indented by the same padding, so it lines up with the icons.
a11y: Each column is a list named by its heading (aria-labelledby).
The current page has aria-current="page" and a background, not only color.
content: Column headings: one or two words.
Description: one short line that says what you find there.
do: Use the same icons on desktop and mobile.
dont: Put actions (buttons, forms) in the columns. The featured block may have one link.
